method:
Known v20 candidate replay diagnostics through production v21 verify.

These component calls do not publish documents. Gold labels are evaluator-only.
Invalid audit/transport results never count as correct negative semantic decisions.
No mechanical number guard is used: this isolates the semantic audit protocol.

suite.method: Component replay of retained v20 rejected candidates through v21 verify. Known regression diagnostics, not fresh holdouts, new generation or whole-document quality. Primary-agent labels from original passages: the storage-using relationship is unsupported; remaining candidates are faithful. Labels stay outside inference. Original artifacts are unchanged.

properties, units, qualifiers and relationships, not just shared words or numbers.
Two independent facts do not establish a causal, instrumental or purpose relationship.

are not. Mark supported only if every assertion follows and unestablished is empty.
